question: Who among the following was the head of the Indian Statutory Commission of 1928?
solution:
The correct answer is** "Sir John Allsebrook Simon".** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The** Indian Statutory Commission** is also known as Simon Commission.
 
• It was a group of seven members of parliament.
 
• This commission came in **1928.**
